assertions.evidence: In the code, deterministic checks run before the model call: `if (lead.headcount > 1000) { ... }` and `if (new Set(lead.regions).size >= 3) { ... }` precede the fetch to the Decisions API.
The model is called via `POST https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions` with `model: "typesafe/jev-1.13"`, which is a version-pinned ID.
The request `state` only includes `{ looking_for: lead.lookingFor }`, omitting headcount and region count.
